cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. On tomorrow's house tour, will you say my diagram revealed the hidden doorway? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum spent all week stripping that wall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Credit her work. Then say who spotted the door before we stripped it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll let you open it for the visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Introduce me as the person who found it, or they'll think I'm holding it for them.
